_comment: Example provider registry config for pkgs/idp-provider (Slice 3, #13409). The REAL config lives on-host with the provider (point IDP_PROVIDER_CONFIG at it) and is never committed: it carries the owner's credential HASH. Generate the hash on-host with `IDP_LOCAL_CREDENTIAL=... idp-provider hash-credential`. An empty hash verifies nothing, so this example cannot open the door.
